description:
Unofficial Telegram Desktop client with extra features and enhancements.

64Gram is an unofficial fork of Telegram Desktop that provides native 64-bit builds along with several additional features, UI customizations, and quality-of-life enhancements.
v1.2.13 (TDesktop v7.4.4)
- [Fix] Built-in updater
- [Change] Rename binary and application data path to 64Gram

NOTE:
Due to changes in the built-in updater, a manual reinstallation (or update via winget) is required this time to receive future auto-updates.
Additionally, the Windows application data path has changed from %APPDATA%\Telegram Desktop to %APPDATA%\64Gram.
